name: ezTalks
description_en:
The current ezTalks website presents business SMS/MMS, voice calling, fax, virtual numbers and contacts. It does not substantiate the old candidate’s video-conferencing identity. This profile follows the current domain evidence while retaining the historical catalogue category for coordination.

Its operating model is prepaid credits and service usage, plus number rental. “No subscription cost” for the account does not mean all communication or phone numbers are free.
description_zh:
当前 ezTalks 官网介绍企业短信/彩信、语音、传真、虚拟号码及联系人，未证明旧候选的视频会议身份。本文依据当前域名证据，原目录分类仅作为协调历史保留。

运营模式为预付额度和服务用量，另有号码租赁。“账户无订阅费”不表示所有通信或号码免费。

core_features.explanation_en: Send/receive SMS and organize two-way customer conversations.
core_features.explanation_zh: 发送/接收短信并组织客户双向对话。

core_features.explanation_en: Select numbers and communication services under separate usage/rental conditions.
core_features.explanation_zh: 按独立用量/租赁条件选择号码及通信服务。

en: Create an account, select a suitable number and destination route, fund credits and prepare consented contacts/content. Inspect one sent message, reply and billed record before scaling a campaign. The pricing FAQ says failed outgoing SMS is not charged, but this research did not test carrier delivery or error classification. A platform send record is not proof that every handset displayed the message.
zh: 创建账户、选择适当号码及目的地路径、充值并准备已同意联系人/内容。扩大活动前，应检查一条发送、回应及账单记录。FAQ 表示失败的发出短信不收费，但本文未测试运营商送达或错误分类，平台发送记录不证明所有手机显示消息。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative evaluation workflow; no customer adoption or savings measured.

pricing.billing_basis: Prepaid usage plus number rental; finite signup credits, destination/type-specific rates and missing values need checking.
pricing.source_snapshot_en: Prepaid usage plus number rental; finite signup credits, destination/type-specific rates and missing values need checking.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 预付用量加号码租赁；注册送额有限，目的地/类型费率及缺值需核对。

sources.title: All-In-One SMS, Voice & Fax Online Platform | eztalks
sources.research_notes_en: Current SMS/voice/fax platform identity supersedes unverified old conferencing description.

sources.title: SMS, MMS, Voice, and Fax plan and pricing | eztalks
sources.research_notes_en: Prepaid usage, destination/number-type rates, number rental periods and limited signup credit.

official_check.scope: Public official documents only; no account, purchase, hands-on test, independent review, identity or publication approval.

review_notes: Original English synthesis and corresponding Chinese translation from attached official sources. Product behavior is vendor-documented, not independently tested.
All records remain draft. Chinese prose does not establish a Chinese software interface.

sections.title_en: Example: message customers and inspect replies
sections.title_zh: 示例：向客户发消息并检查回应
sections.en:
Create an account, select a suitable number and destination route, fund credits and prepare consented contacts/content. Inspect one sent message, reply and billed record before scaling a campaign. The pricing FAQ says failed outgoing SMS is not charged, but this research did not test carrier delivery or error classification. A platform send record is not proof that every handset displayed the message.

For voice/fax, evaluate those channels separately; old meeting features cannot be inferred from the brand name.
sections.zh:
创建账户、选择适当号码及目的地路径、充值并准备已同意联系人/内容。扩大活动前，应检查一条发送、回应及账单记录。FAQ 表示失败的发出短信不收费，但本文未测试运营商送达或错误分类，平台发送记录不证明所有手机显示消息。

语音/传真应分别评估，不能从品牌名称推导旧会议能力。

sections.en:
The page describes pay-as-you-go with no account/setup fee and lists number rentals over seven/fourteen days, a month or a year. Its destination/type selector contains missing values and incomplete price rows; do not treat one displayed SMS rate as worldwide pricing. The signup FAQ offers a US/Canada number and USD 0.50 test balance, which is finite trial credit.

Confirm currency, sender eligibility, rental renewal, segments, inbound/outbound charges and refund conditions for the actual route. The account’s no-subscription statement coexists with paid number rental and communication usage.
sections.zh:
页面介绍按用量、不收账户/配置费，号码可租七/十四天、一个月或一年。目的地/类型选择器有缺值和不完整费率行，不能把某条短信费率当全球价格。注册 FAQ 提供美/加号码及 USD 0.50 测试余额，属于有限试用额度。

应按实际路径确认货币、发送资格、号码续租、分段、收发费用及退款条件。账户不收订阅费，与号码和通信收费同时存在。

sections.title_en: Current communications service, not verified video meetings
sections.title_zh: 当前通信服务，未核实视频会议
sections.en:
Customer-messaging operations can evaluate the current offer; a buyer seeking multiparty video meetings lacks current supporting evidence on these pages. No domain-ownership continuity beyond the present official site was established, so historical product claims remain unverified.

No message, call, fax, number purchase, identity/permission check, licence, self-hosted distribution or recovery was tested. The site’s compliance claims are not independent certification evidence.
sections.zh:
客户消息运营可评估当前方案，寻找多人视频会议的买家在这些页面缺少现时依据。除当前官网外，未证明历史域名所有权连续性，旧产品主张仍未核实。

未测试消息、通话、传真、号码购买、身份/权限、许可、自托管发行版或恢复。网站合规陈述不是独立认证证据。

content_method.author: Codex (AI assistant)
content_method.method: Public primary-source research, original English editorial synthesis and Chinese translation. Examples and evaluation recommendations were not executed.

research_gaps.en: Historical video-product continuity, exact route pricing, number eligibility, delivery, licence and restore unverified.
research_gaps.zh: 历史视频产品连续性、具体路径价格、号码资格、送达、许可及恢复未核实。
